title: Controller LCFB1
text: 用于汽轮机-调速器模型的负载控制器，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Speed reference (pu)} 指定转速参考、{Initial power reference, P_ref0 (pu)} 指定初始功率参考、{Controller deadband (pu)} 控制器死区、{Maximum error, e_max (pu)} 指定最大误差、{Frequency bias gain, f_b (pu)} 指定频率偏置增益、{Proportional gain, K_p (pu)} 指定 PI 控制的比例增益、{Integral gain, K_i (pu/s)} 指定 PI 控制的积分增益、{Power transducer time constant, T_pelec (s)} 指定功率传感器的时间常数、{Maximum output, I_rmax (pu)} 输出上限，按实例取值。

params.name: Proportional gain, K_p (pu)
params.values: PI 控制的比例增益 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Integral gain, K_i (pu/s)
params.values: PI 控制的积分增益 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Power transducer time constant, T_pelec (s)
params.values: 功率传感器的时间常数 3.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
